entries.1a4429e280465187: As its construction-related business, it rents and sells construction machinery and temporary construction materials in Japan and overseas. Group companies borrow rental assets from the company as needed, and the company also borrows rental assets from group companies and rents them to other companies. Other businesses include sales of building materials such as steel products, rental and sales of computers and peripheral equipment, and rental and sales of nursing care products.

entries.2c8580dc1505b158: This is the company group's core business and its only reportable segment, renting and selling construction machinery and temporary construction materials in Japan and overseas. In Japan, the company and other group companies such as Kanki Co., Ltd., Central Co., Ltd., Nishiken Co., Ltd. and Unite Co., Ltd. rent and sell construction machinery. Some group companies design, sell and rent temporary unit houses, and rent and sell special machinery for ground improvement and shield tunneling methods, measuring instruments and road construction machinery. Overseas, it has bases in Australia, China, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and the Philippines. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥190,225 million, accounting for the largest part of consolidated revenue.

entries.9a372a5e57126b2b: Keeping in mind that “the customer’s profit is our profit,” its management policy is to constantly seek change and revitalize the company. Its medium-term management plan, “Progress 65 – Toward Balancing Growth and Efficiency” (fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2029), names three priority measures, “growth strategy and improvement of capital efficiency,” “strengthening the DX strategy,” and “commitment to sustainability,” and aims to build a solid earnings base that is not affected by the business environment.
